QuestInfo.name: In Search of Lost Time
QuestInfo.0: Grandpa Clock is much better now after being wound up and havign the Cog replaced. But for some reason the arms on the clock do not more. There is a sad story behind it.
QuestInfo.1: Clock hands do not move in Ludibrium where time has stopped. But Grandpa Clock tells you that is is a sad thing to be born a clock and still not be able to tell time. Granpa Clock wants an opportunity to tell time.
QuestInfo.2: You deliver the Power of Time that the Timer possessed. Grandpa Clock can now tell time and is happy.

0.0: Yes! I can feel the POWER with these new cogs. Now...if only my blasted hands would move! You know why that is, of course. With time stopped in Ludibrium, no clock hands can move.
0.1: Can you imagine what it's like? To be built for a purpose you can never fulfill? One has to wonder why they exist at all, why they were brought into the world...
0.3: ...Yes? If you're gonna help, then offer to help. Don't just stand around.

yes.0: Do you know anything about the #rTimer#k? It's a monster that lives in the deepest part of the Clocktower. It eats time, if that makes any sense. If you can get the #r#t4033862##k from it, then maybe I can use that to tell time myself.

no.0: You must be sick and tired of doing me favors. Ah well, I guess I'll just learn to deal with it. Ha!

1.0: Ooh, I can feel my lost powers coming back!

yes.0: Tick tock tick tock. Ahhhh.... This FEELING that I'd forgotten for so long!

default.0: If I could get a #r#t4033862##k from #rTimer#k then I could reclaim my lost time...
